licenses.text:
Tyndale New Testament, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/engtnt/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this
translation):
> "Tyndale New Testament
The Tyndale New Testament (1534)
Public Domain
Language: English
Dialect: archaic British
Translation by: William Tyndale"

Why this is public domain:
First published in 1534. William Tyndale died in 1536 (Wikidata), so the work is public domain in the United Kingdom (its country of origin) and in the United States.

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page
(https://ebible.org/details.php?id=engtnt) and the edition's own files.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-engtnt-87334236, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training. eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside.
